in_telugu.name: ధర్మన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who upholds Duty and Righteousness

in_marathi.name: Dharman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharman is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'dhar', which means 'to uphold' or 'to maintain'. In Hinduism, Dharman represents the moral and ethical values that one must uphold to lead a righteous and virtuous life. It is a name revered by parents who wish to instill a strong sense of duty and morality in their child.
